Affiliates

The Daniela and Will Travel Blog receives compensation through affiliate relationships with merchants listed on this site. Please know that this in no way affects reviews, videos, content, or this site's opinions of products, services, manufacturers, partners, or merchants. The mission of the Daniela and Will Travel Blog is to provide the best functionality for this site's users, regardless of any potential affiliate commissions.

Earning and keeping the trust of our audience is our top priorrity. Here are our core guiding principles (adapted from The Verge):

  • We do not accept preconditions for coverage that requires us to say certain things
  • We do not allow writers to cover people or companies where they have a personal conflict
  • We do not make paid endorsements of any kind
  • We do not personally invest in companies we cover

Advertising

Our writers do not directly accept money or other consideration from individuals or entities as a condition or incentive to write a review or story, whether favorable or unfavorable. However, some of our editorial content is made possible through the support of sponsors. This content is clearly marked as content “Presented” by the applicable sponsor.

Some of our content may contain marketing links, which means we will receive a commission for purchases made via those links. In our editorial content, these affiliate links appear automatically, and our writers are not influenced by our affiliate partnerships.

We work with multiple partners (including Awin), with the entire list available below. You can find out more about their services by visiting their sites.

Distributed Platforms

The Daniela and Will Travel Blog brand is distributed across many platforms, including our own sites on the web, Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, and others. Our editorial standards apply to all platforms.

Reviews

Advising our audience about the best way to spend their time and money is one of our most important responsibilities. Our reviews always contain the honest, independent assessments of our editorial team. Like everything else we publish, there are no paid-for reviews of any kind.

We will only review and recommend products and services that we have personally used and believe in. We will never accept payment to review a product or service.

Individual Partners

The Daniela and Will Travel Blog is a participant in the Amazon.ca, Inc. Associates Program and/or Amazon.com, Inc. Associates Program, an affiliate advertising program designed to provide a means for sites to earn advertising fees by advertising and linking to Amazon.ca and/or Amazon.com.
